run_flask_server: run the flask app to serve the craftassist Minecraft server management endpoints on localhost
launch_ecs_instance: launch a new ECS Fargate task for a Minecraft server instance with a flat world config
check_instance_status: check the progress and public IP of an ECS task by querying its network attachment and port
check_instance_expired: check if an ECS task instance has expired by verifying its last status against running states
encode_decode_base64: encode a string to base64 or decode a base64 string back to plain text using helper functions
